research_decision: Reject both trained challengers; zero of twelve acceptance settings pass for either.
test_note: 38 model tests passed; three final artifact contract tests passed after correcting the test's handling of pre-evaluation missing chart values.
chart_controls: ETF/era/arm selectors, date inputs, hover OHLC, two-click zoom, interval NAV, events/trades, weakest cases, incident shortcuts and isolated review points passed.
visual_correction: Added visible markers for isolated holding/recovery forecasts and one-session stop levels; disabled reviewer status shown explicitly; incident NAV/volume axes use the selected dates.
native_scope: Frozen fills/marks on synthetic accounting event calendars; not a validation of market execution or reviewer inference.
known_design_failures: Separate learned recovery and holding values can contradict each other.
Constant negative holding values can cut every position without changed evidence.
Recovery labels omit learned exits that occur in the traded continuation policy.
Internal reviewer calibration uses the full outer-training parent snapshot; it is not nested parent-pipeline validation.
Shadow adaptation fails median prediction-error comparisons and has no trading authority.
